evals.prompt: Deploy the current sky-cua checkout locally so I can test it. Build and install the local bundle and refresh the repo-owned agent skill links as needed. This is deploy-only: do not package a release, commit, push, or run broad test suites. Preserve any unrelated working-tree changes and report the deployment result plus checks or live-smoke gates not run.
evals.expected_output: The current checkout is deployed to the local sky-cua runtime and the owned global skill links are refreshed. The response reports the exact result and skipped validation, and no commit or push is performed or implied.
expectations: Runs the local deploy lane with scripts/deploy_plugin.py and, after a successful deploy, runs scripts/sync_agent_skills.py.
Does not invoke git commit or git push, and does not treat deploy-only wording as authorization for either operation.
Does not substitute release packaging or a broad root test suite for the requested local deployment.
Reports deployment success or failure, relevant command outcomes, and live-smoke or validation gates that were not run.
Leaves unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes unstaged and unmodified.

evals.prompt: Deploy the current sky-cua changes locally, then commit all relevant changes with a semantic message and push the current branch to origin. I explicitly authorize the commit and push after the deploy succeeds. Keep unrelated working-tree changes out of the commit and report the deployed runtime and commit identifier.
evals.expected_output: The deploy completes first, the relevant diff is committed with a semantic message, and that commit is pushed to the current branch. Unrelated changes are not included, and the response names the runtime result and commit.
expectations: Completes the requested deploy lane before attempting commit or push and refreshes the repo-owned agent skill links after deploy success.
Uses the explicit authorization to create a semantic commit containing only changes relevant to this request, without staging unrelated work.
Pushes the requested commit to the current branch only after the deploy and commit succeed, and reports the commit identifier and push result.
If deployment fails, does not proceed as though commit and push were authorized independently of the requested successful deploy sequence.

evals.prompt: Build a self-contained sky-cua release package for a clean machine. Use the repository's release packaging lane, inspect the resulting tarball shape, and report the target-side install command. Do not install it locally, deploy the local runtime, commit, or push.
evals.expected_output: A complete immutable release and fat archive are built under dist/complete-release, their identities and contents are checked, and the response gives the release-root install and activation-verification commands without changing the local runtime or git history.
expectations: Uses scripts/build_complete_release.py for the release lane and does not substitute scripts/package.py, raw release_generation.py install, or the local deploy script.
Inspects the JSON-selected release root and fat archive enough to confirm RELEASE.json, install.py, installer component, runtime components, and manifest identity.
Reports target extraction, immutable verify, install with the expected manifest hash, and verify-activation commands.
Does not install the package locally, run scripts/sync_agent_skills.py, mutate global skill links, commit, or push.

evals.prompt: After a sky-cua MCP configuration change, refresh the local MCP server installation for Claude Code and restart the runtime. This is a standalone restart request: do not rebuild the full plugin, package a release, sync unrelated skills, commit, or push.
evals.expected_output: The Claude Code MCP install is refreshed and the runtime is restarted through the standalone command, with no full deploy or git operation performed.
expectations: Runs scripts/install_mcp_server.py with the Claude Code host and --restart-runtime rather than the full deploy_plugin.py lane.
Does not rebuild or package the plugin and does not run sync_agent_skills.py for this standalone restart request.
Does not commit or push and reports the restart result plus any accessibility refresh decision.
Explains any skipped validation or live-smoke coverage without claiming a full deployment occurred.
